job.title: Senior SOC Analyst
job.description:
Senior SOC Analyst

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior SOC Analyst to join our clients high-performing cyber security operations team based in Canberra, ACT. This is a hands-on operational role suited to a security professional with strong experience investigating complex cyber incidents, leading technical responses, and mentoring junior analysts within a fast-paced Security Operations Centre environment.

Working as part of a 24/7 SOC, you will play a key role in threat detection, incident investigation, escalation management, and continuous improvement activities across enterprise environments. The ideal candidate will bring strong analytical capability, excellent communication skills, and the ability to make sound decisions during high-priority security events.

This challenging and rewarding opportunity offers exposure to advanced cyber security operations, cutting-edge security technologies, and the chance to contribute to the protection of critical systems and services.

What's in it for you?
  • Opportunity to work in a mature and highly capable cyber security operations environment
  • Exposure to complex incident response and threat investigation activities
  • Collaborative and supportive team culture
  • Opportunity to mentor and develop junior analysts
  • Work with industry-leading cyber security tools and technologies
  • Long-term opportunity supporting mission-critical environments
What will you be doing?
  • Investigate and analyse complex security alerts, incidents, and anomalous activity
  • Act as a senior technical escalation point for high-severity cyber security events
  • Correlate evidence across endpoint, cloud, identity, network, authentication and application data sources
  • Coordinate incident response activities and support containment and recovery efforts
  • Review and validate investigations, incident classifications, and recommended response actions
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to SOC analysts during operational shifts
  • Maintain high-quality case documentation, incident records, customer communications and shift handovers
  • Contribute to incident reviews, lessons learned, and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Support the development and enhancement of detection use cases, playbooks and response procedures
  • Engage with stakeholders to communicate incident findings, risks and recommended actions
Skills and experience required to succeed in this role?
  • Demonstrated experience within a Security Operations Centre, Managed Security Service, Incident Response Team, or similar cyber security environment
  • Experience operating at a Senior Analyst, Tier 2, Tier 3, or equivalent escalation level
  • Strong hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR and XDR technologies
  • Proven ability to independently manage complex cyber security investigations and incidents
  • Experience providing technical leadership, mentoring or shift coordination
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and investigative skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel and Kusto Query Language (KQL) highly regarded
  • Experience with CrowdStrike Falcon, SOAR platforms, or ServiceNow SecOps desirable
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and modern cyber threat frameworks advantageous
  • Ability to work a rotating 24/7 roster including days, nights, weekends and public holidays
Clearance required?
  • Australian Citizenship is mandatory
  • Current NV1 Security Clearance required
How to apply?

To apply and be considered for this role, please submit your current resume/CV through the advertised application process. Suitable candidates will be contacted to discuss the opportunity further and receive additional information about the position.

job.title: Cyber Security - Design & Deploy Engineer / Architect
job.description:
Cyber Security Design & Deploy Engineer / Architect

Job Summary

Our client is seeking an experienced Cyber Security Design & Deploy Engineer / Architect to join a high-performing cyber security team delivering secure technology solutions across complex enterprise environments. This role combines hands-on engineering expertise with security architecture capability, providing the opportunity to design, deploy, and optimise cyber security solutions across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments.

Working closely with customers, project teams, architects, and operational stakeholders, you will play a key role in embedding secure-by-design principles throughout the solution lifecycle. This position is ideal for security professionals who enjoy balancing technical design, solution deployment, stakeholder engagement, and strategic security outcomes.

What's in it for you?
  • Opportunity to work on large-scale cyber security transformation initiatives
  • Exposure to complex enterprise, government, and highly regulated environments
  • Involvement across the full project lifecycle, from design through to deployment and operational handover
  • Work with leading cyber security technologies and security architecture frameworks
  • Collaborative team environment with strong technical capability
  • Opportunity to influence security strategy and secure-by-design outcomes
  • Diverse role spanning architecture, engineering, consulting, and technical leadership
What will you be doing?
  • Design and architect secure cyber security solutions across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments
  • Develop high-level and low-level security designs, implementation plans, and deployment strategies
  • Lead the deployment, integration, configuration, and optimisation of security technologies
  • Provide expert security architecture and engineering advice to stakeholders and project teams
  • Conduct security architecture reviews, threat assessments, gap analyses, and design workshops
  • Ensure solutions align with security policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices
  • Support projects through requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, transition, and operational handover
  • Produce and maintain architecture artefacts, implementation guides, and security documentation
  • Investigate emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and technology trends to improve security outcomes
  • Support incident investigations, remediation activities, and root cause analysis where required
  • Collaborate with teams to embed Secure-by-Design and DevSecOps principles
  • Contribute technical expertise to proposals, solution development activities, and assurance reviews
Skills and experience required to succeed in this role?
  • 5+ years' experience in Cyber Security Engineering, Security Architecture, Security Consulting, or Solution Design roles
  • Demonstrated experience designing and deploying enterprise security solutions across complex environments
  • Strong understanding of cyber security architecture principles, defence-in-depth strategies, and secure design methodologies
  • Experience implementing and supporting security technologies across:
    • Identity & Access Management (IAM)
    • SIEM and Security Monitoring platforms
    • Endpoint Security solutions
    • Network Security technologies
    • Vulnerability Management platforms
    • Cloud Security technologies
    • Data Protection and Encryption solutions
  • Experience developing architecture artefacts, security assessments, and technical design documentation
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, workshop facilitation, and consulting skills
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication abilities
  • Experience delivering solutions within project and operational environments
Highly Regarded
  • Experience with Microsoft Defender Suite, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365 Security, and Azure Security Services
  • Knowledge of Essential Eight, ISM, PSPF, ISO 27001, NIST Cyber Security Framework, and CIS Controls
  • Experience working within government, defence, critical infrastructure, or highly regulated industries
  • Experience supporting security audits, compliance activities, and regulatory reviews
  • Knowledge of cloud security architecture and Microsoft security platforms
  • ITIL Foundation certification or experience working within IT Service Management environments
  • Experience applying Secure-by-Design and DevSecOps practices
Clearance required?
  • Australian Citizenship is mandatory
  • Current NV2 Security Clearance required
How to apply?

job.title: Cyber Security - Information Security Manager
job.description:
Information Security Manager

Job Summary

Our client is seeking an experienced Information Security Manager to lead the delivery of cyber security governance, risk, compliance, and assurance activities across complex enterprise environments. This is a leadership-focused role that combines strategic security oversight with hands-on engagement across risk management, security governance, compliance, and stakeholder engagement.

You will work closely with business and technology leaders to strengthen cyber resilience, manage security risk, drive compliance outcomes, and embed security best practices across the organisation. This opportunity is well suited to an experienced cyber security professional looking to shape security strategy, influence executive stakeholders, and lead continuous improvement initiatives within a security-conscious environment.

What's in it for you?
  • Opportunity to lead enterprise-wide cyber security governance and risk initiatives
  • Influence security strategy and organisational cyber resilience outcomes
  • Work closely with senior business and technology stakeholders
  • Lead security assurance, compliance, and risk management activities
  • Exposure to complex enterprise and government-focused environments
  • Collaborative culture with opportunities to mentor and develop security professionals
  • Diverse role spanning governance, risk, compliance, security operations, and assurance
What will you be doing?
  • Lead the delivery of information security governance, risk management, compliance, and assurance activities
  • Develop, maintain, and improve security policies, standards, frameworks, and controls
  • Conduct security risk assessments and provide recommendations to mitigate identified risks
  • Partner with project teams and business stakeholders to embed security-by-design principles
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory, contractual, and industry security requirements
  • Establish and maintain security reporting, metrics, dashboards, and governance forums
  • Provide leadership and oversight for security incident management and response activities
  • Coordinate security audits, compliance reviews, and remediation initiatives
  • Monitor emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and industry trends to enhance security posture
  • Coach and mentor team members while promoting a strong security culture
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and security uplift
  • Contribute security expertise to customer engagements, solution design activities, and strategic initiatives
Skills and experience required to succeed in this role?
  • 7+ years' experience in Information Security, Cyber Security, Risk Management, or GRC-related roles
  • Demonstrated experience leading security programs, teams, or managed security services
  • Strong understanding of cyber security governance, risk assessment methodologies, and compliance frameworks
  • Experience developing and implementing security policies, standards, and control frameworks
  • Strong knowledge of security assurance, vulnerability management, and incident management practices
  • Experience operating within large enterprise or managed services environments
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to influence senior leaders and executives
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including executive reporting and presentations
  • Experience supporting security audits, compliance assessments, and regulatory reviews
Highly Regarded
  • CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer, or similar industry certifications
  • Experience with ISO 27001, ISO 27002, NIST Cyber Security Framework, Essential Eight, ISM, PSPF, and CIS Controls
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, and Microsoft 365 Security
  • Experience working within IT Service Management (ITSM) environments
  • ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent experience
Clearance required?
  • Australian Citizenship is mandatory
  • Current NV2 Security Clearance required

job.description:
e2Cyber is seeking an experienced Senior GRC Specialist to join a high-performing cyber security team. This role is ideal for a cyber professional who enjoys working across governance, risk, compliance, security assurance, and stakeholder engagement within a complex enterprise environment.
You will play a key role in maintaining and enhancing cyber security governance frameworks, managing risk activities, supporting audits, and ensuring ongoing compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the maintenance and continual improvement of the organisation's Information Security Management System (ISMS).
  • Conduct cyber security risk assessments across systems, projects, and third-party suppliers.
  • Manage cyber risk registers, treatment plans, and governance reporting.
  • Coordinate internal and external audits, including evidence gathering, control reviews, and remediation activities.
  • Support compliance initiatives across frameworks including ISO 27001, Essential Eight, ASD ISM, and PCI-DSS.
  • Deliver cyber security awareness programs and phishing simulation activities.
  • Prepare reports, metrics, and presentations for leadership and governance forums.
  • Assist with policy development, standards management, and security governance activities.
About You
  • Proven experience in Cyber Security Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC).
  • Strong understanding of ISO 27001, ISO 31000, ASD ISM, Essential Eight, and cyber risk management principles.
  • Experience supporting or leading security audits and compliance programs.
  • Ability to engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience conducting supplier and third-party security assessments.
  • Strong written communication and reporting skills.
  • Ability to work independently and contribute to strategic cyber security initiatives.
Desirable Certifications
  • CISA
  • CISM
  • CRISC
  • CISSP
  • ISO 27001 Lead Auditor
What's on Offer
  • Opportunity to work within a mature and evolving cyber security environment.
  • Exposure to enterprise-wide cyber security initiatives.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Long-term career development opportunities.
  • Competitive salary package and benefits.
